_note: The disk watch (robofast/diskwatch.py; docs/diskwatch.md): free space on every computer, as console alarms.
python -m robofast.diskwatch --config /etc/robofast/diskwatch.json --once   # one pass, a table
The console reads status ("diskwatch" in its config) and so the notifier sends its alarms.
path: statvfs on the gateway: its own disks, and the other computers' through its CIFS/NFS mounts.
ssh: df -Pk (linux) or wmic (windows) over ssh with a key only (BatchMode); every fixed disk is a row,
including drives no share exposes. The key and known_hosts come from systemd LoadCredential=
(deploy/robofast-diskwatch.service). volume: two targets on one disk alarm once (docs/diskwatch.md).
Thresholds at the top apply to every target; a target may set its own (null turns one off).
Every host and address is a placeholder (192.0.2.x, example.org).
